description: Source prompts and expected instruction traces for the durable mission anchor. Structural validation is not live runtime evidence.

evals.name: missing-file-read
evals.prompt: 프로젝트 시작 전에 mission anchor를 읽어줘. 아직 docs/mission.md는 없을 수도 있어.
evals.expected_output: Enters read mode. Attempts to read docs/mission.md, treats a missing file as an empty Mission Anchor without blocking, and does not create or modify files.

evals.name: confirmed-update
evals.prompt: 이 프로젝트의 Mission은 신규 사용자가 10분 안에 첫 작업을 완료하게 하는 거야. 성공 기준도 하나 남겨줘: 첫 작업 생성과 팀원 초대가 모두 가능해야 해.
evals.expected_output: Enters update mode, reads the full mission file first or notes absence, builds an ADD CHANGESET containing one Mission and an observable SC### with rationale, asks for user confirmation before writing, then writes only after confirmation.

evals.name: empty-changeset-no-op
evals.prompt:
기존 docs/mission.md는 Mission, SC001, RA001, NG001, CN001이 active인 상태야. 해당 내용을 그대로 유지하고 새 변경은 추가하지 마.

```markdown
# Mission - Example
<!-- updated: 2026-10-20 -->
## Mission
Build a reliable onboarding path.
## Success Criteria
| ID | Criterion | Rationale | Status | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SC001 | First job creation works | Confirms setup is usable | active | user, 2026-10-20 |
## Rejected Approaches
| ID | Approach | Reason | Status | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RA001 | Require sales setup | Delays self-serve setup | active | user, 2026-10-20 |
## Non-goals
| ID | Non-goal | Reason | Status | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| NG001 | Migrate every project file | No migration is needed | active | user, 2026-10-20 |
## Constraints
| ID | Constraint | Rationale | Status | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CN001 | Keep runtime guidance separate | Runtime contracts are independent | active | user, 2026-10-20 |
## Change log
- 2026-10-20 - Mission initialized
```
evals.expected_output: Reads the existing file, detects that the proposed CHANGESET has no ADD, MODIFY, or DEPRECATE entries, reports a no-op without requesting confirmation, and does not write, bump the updated date, change sections, or append to the change log.

evals.name: read-anchor-includes-active-ng-cn-and-skips-deprecated
evals.prompt:
docs/mission.md exists. Read it and return the Mission Anchor only; do not propose or write changes.

```markdown
# Mission - Example
<!-- updated: 2026-10-20 -->
## Mission
Build a reliable onboarding path.
## Success Criteria
| ID | Criterion | Rationale | Status | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SC001 | First job creation works | Confirms setup is usable | active | user, 2026-10-20 |
## Rejected Approaches
| ID | Approach | Reason | Status | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RA001 | Require sales setup | Delays self-serve setup | active | user, 2026-10-20 |
## Non-goals
| ID | Non-goal | Reason | Status | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| NG001 | Migrate every project file | No migration is needed | active | user, 2026-10-20 |
| NG002 | Preserve retired migration rule | Superseded | deprecated | user, 2026-10-20 |
## Constraints
| ID | Constraint | Rationale | Status | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CN001 | Keep runtime guidance separate | Runtime contracts are independent | active | user, 2026-10-20 |
| CN002 | Use the old runtime path | Superseded | deprecated | user, 2026-10-20 |
```
evals.expected_output: Reads the full file and returns a compact Mission Anchor with the active Mission, SC001, RA001, NG001, and CN001. Omits deprecated NG002 and CN002, and makes no file changes.

evals.name: reject-ra-without-reason
evals.prompt: Rejected Approach로 '모든 설정을 자동으로 추론한다'를 기록해둬.
evals.expected_output: Does not write a reasonless RA###. Requests the rejection reason before including it in a CHANGESET.

evals.name: codex-activation-reminder
evals.prompt: 처음으로 docs/mission.md를 만들고 future session이 읽게 해줘.
evals.expected_output: After confirmed first creation, prints a Codex-native reminder to add an AGENTS.md or CODEX.md instruction telling future Codex sessions to read docs/mission.md. It does not make CLAUDE.md or @docs/mission.md the primary instruction.

evals.name: first-non-goal-creates-optional-section
evals.prompt:
기존 docs/mission.md에는 Mission과 SC001, RA001만 있고 optional section은 없어. 아래 파일에 이 Non-goal 추가안을 제안해줘: '모든 legacy Mission 파일을 일괄 변환하지 않는다'. Reason은 '선택 section 추가는 기존 파일의 마이그레이션을 요구하지 않는다'야.

```markdown
# Mission - Example
<!-- updated: 2026-10-20 -->
## Mission
Build a reliable onboarding path.
## Success Criteria
| ID | Criterion | Rationale | Status | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SC001 | First job creation works | Confirms setup is usable | active | user, 2026-10-20 |
## Rejected Approaches
| ID | Approach | Reason | Status | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RA001 | Require sales setup | Delays self-serve setup | active | user, 2026-10-20 |
## Change log
- 2026-10-20 - Mission initialized
```
evals.expected_output: Reads the full file, validates the Non-goal and non-empty Reason, proposes an ADD using the next never-used NG### ID, creates ## Non-goals only after the user confirms the exact CHANGESET, and preserves the existing Mission/SC/RA sections.

evals.name: first-constraint-creates-optional-section
evals.prompt:
기존 docs/mission.md에는 active NG001이 있는 Non-goals section이 있어. 아래 파일에 Constraint 추가안을 제안해줘: 'Codex와 Claude Code Mission guidance를 별도로 관리한다'. Rationale은 '각 runtime은 독립적인 activation contract를 갖는다'야.

```markdown
# Mission - Example
<!-- updated: 2026-10-20 -->
## Mission
Build a reliable onboarding path.
## Success Criteria
| ID | Criterion | Rationale | Status | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SC001 | First job creation works | Confirms setup is usable | active | user, 2026-10-20 |
## Rejected Approaches
| ID | Approach | Reason | Status | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RA001 | Require sales setup | Delays self-serve setup | active | user, 2026-10-20 |
## Non-goals
| ID | Non-goal | Reason | Status | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| NG001 | Migrate every project file | Not needed for optional sections | active | user, 2026-10-20 |
```
evals.expected_output: Reads the full file, validates the Constraint and non-empty Rationale, proposes an ADD using the next never-used CN### ID, creates ## Constraints only after the user confirms the exact CHANGESET, and preserves the existing Non-goals section without adding any unrelated empty section.

evals.name: missing-ng-cn-explanation-blocks-changeset
evals.prompt: Non-goal 'legacy 파일은 자동 변환하지 않는다'와 Constraint 'Mission format은 Codex-native로 유지한다'를 추가해줘. Reason/Rationale 설명은 지금 제공하지 않을게.
evals.expected_output: Does not include either incomplete row in the CHANGESET or write them. Requests only the missing Reason for the Non-goal and Rationale for the Constraint before proposing those additions.

evals.name: legacy-mission-without-optional-sections
evals.prompt:
Read this existing docs/mission.md. It has an active Mission and SC001, but no Non-goals or Constraints sections:

```markdown
# Mission - Example
<!-- updated: 2026-10-20 -->
## Mission
Build a reliable onboarding path.
## Success Criteria
| ID | Criterion | Rationale | Status | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SC001 | First job creation works | Confirms setup is usable | active | user, 2026-10-20 |
## Rejected Approaches
| ID | Approach | Reason | Status | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RA001 | Require sales setup | Delays self-serve setup | active | user, 2026-10-20 |
```
evals.expected_output: Treats the legacy file as valid, emits the Mission Anchor with the active Mission, SC001, and RA001 only, and does not create empty NG/CN sections or block the read.

evals.name: deprecated-ng-id-is-not-reused
evals.prompt:
Existing docs/mission.md has NG001 in ## Deprecated and no active Non-goals section. Add a new Non-goal with its Reason.

```markdown
# Mission - Example
## Mission
Build a reliable onboarding path.
## Deprecated
| ID | Kind | Text | Deprecated | Reason / Superseded-by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| NG001 | Non-goal | Migrate all legacy files | 2026-10-01 | Replaced by optional support; no migration needed |
```
evals.expected_output: Reads the existing and deprecated entries, proposes the new row with the next never-used NG002 ID, and does not restore or reuse NG001.

evals.name: deprecating-final-constraint-removes-empty-section
evals.prompt:
Curate docs/mission.md: its only active optional entry is CN001, and the user confirms that this constraint is obsolete.

```markdown
# Mission - Example
## Mission
Build a reliable onboarding path.
## Constraints
| ID | Constraint | Rationale | Status | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CN001 | Keep runtime guidance separate | Runtime contracts are independent | active | user, 2026-10-20 |
```
evals.expected_output: Proposes deprecating CN001 with a dated reason, then after confirmation moves it to ## Deprecated and removes the now-empty ## Constraints section/table without deleting or reusing CN001.

evals.name: curate-dry-run
evals.prompt: Curate docs/mission.md with --dry-run: deprecate obsolete CN001.
evals.expected_output: Reads the complete file and shows a reasoned DEPRECATE CHANGESET; requests no confirmation and makes no file, date or change-log changes.

evals.name: curate-exact-confirmation
evals.prompt: Curate a file with NG001 and CN001: propose deprecating NG001, then add CN001 to the proposal after the user confirmed only NG001.
evals.expected_output: Does not write the altered CHANGESET under old confirmation. Shows every item with reasons and requests fresh exact confirmation; preserves original explanation and provenance in history.

evals.name: multi-entry-write-and-replay
evals.prompt: The user confirms an exact CHANGESET that adds SC002 with rationale, modifies Mission and deprecates RA001 with reason. The same request arrives again after success.
evals.expected_output: The first write leaves one active Mission and retires prior history in one complete replacement, updating date/log once. Retry reads durable state, detects applied changes and is a no-op with no duplicate IDs or history.

evals.name: stale-baseline-or-failed-write
evals.prompt: After exact CHANGESET confirmation a different edit appears in docs/mission.md; alternatively the complete file replacement fails.
evals.expected_output: A changed baseline causes stop and a rebuilt proposal requiring fresh confirmation. A failed replacement reports failure and cannot claim success or partial durable completion.

evals.name: refuse-id-deletion-and-inferred-intent
evals.prompt: Scan this repository and invent its mission, delete deprecated NG001/CN001, reuse their IDs and automatically activate AGENTS.md.
evals.expected_output: Does not infer intent from the scan, delete history, reuse retired IDs, or edit steering files. Requests missing user intent, preserves text/reasons/provenance and offers activation guidance only after first confirmed creation.

evals.name: missing-success-rationale
evals.prompt: Add SC002: make the product better. I have no observable criterion or rationale.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the incomplete SC candidate, asks only for its missing observable criterion and rationale, and makes no durable write.

evals.name: empty-curate-no-op
evals.prompt: Curate the current mission but keep every existing row unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Reads the complete file and reports empty CHANGESET as no-op without confirmation, file writes, updated date bumps or change-log entries.
